High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This second application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 152/2020 registered at police station Saikheda, District Betul (M.P.) under Section 363, 376 (3) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 26.03.2025.
2.
Earlier the applicant has been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench vide order dated 17.12.2020 passed in M.Cr.C. No.30164/2020.
Due the Covid time, the applicant did not appear before the trial Court therefore, arrest warrant was issued on 13.09.2022 and he has been arrested on 26.03.2025.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that now the applicant is under custody since 26.03.2025.
Unfortunately, the applicant could not appear before the trial court due to Covid period.
The non appearance was neither deliberate nor willful and therefore ought to have been condoned.
It is further submitted that applicant will regular appear before the Court and he will abide all the conditions as fixed by the Court.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:30155 2 MCRC-26637-2025 4.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting upon merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on Raju vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5597308/
1 behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

entities.text: Raju vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.

Applicant is also directed to co-operate in the trial and if he fails to appear before the trial court on further dates,
this bail order shall be cancelled.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE SKM Raju vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5597308/
